comment: Codex models for buildings and items (docs/design/codex-models.md). 'prep' is read by tools/codex_prep.py (Blender: GLB from sneed's Rim3D_Codex folder -> assets/raw/codex/<Name>/, not in Git). 'buildings' is read by the GunArt commandlet (-List=assets/codex_art.json): each FBX is imported as one combined mesh, /Game/Rim3D/Generated/Buildings/<name>/SM_<name>, with M_GunPBR instances from the T_<slot>_* maps; the def's visual.mesh names it. The launchers' art is in assets/guns.json. A model with moving parts (the Neon ones, 'parts' in its prep entry) has one entry for its body and one per part, <Name>_<Part>, all in the same frame (docs/design/neon-assets.md). All numbers are ours.
